No current catch or fishing conditions are available from the Palghar district fisheries profile. The Palghar district fisheries profile is a historical document and does not provide current information on fisheries advisories or landing centres.

For the latest fisheries advisories and information on Palghar coverage, please refer to the INCOIS Potential Fishing Zone Advisory and the Maharashtra Department of Fisheries. You can also contact CMFRI for specific fisheries data.

In an immediate emergency, contact the Palghar District Disaster Management control room 02525-297474 or toll-free 1077, or the Maharashtra Disaster Management control room 022-22027990, or the National Disaster Management Authority control room 011-26701728.
